design_philosophy: Ethereal Fintech. A high-motion, hyper-clean light theme built exclusively on the Inter typeface, pristine whites, and kinetic light blues. The UI must feel like a precision instrument—fast, transparent, and breathing with real-time data. We weaponize negative space and radical typographic weights to prevent the 'Inter + Light Theme' from feeling like generic corporate SaaS.

typography.strategy: Since we are constrained to Inter, we must use radical weight contrast to create tension. Never use 'Medium' or 'SemiBold' for large headers. Jump from Light (300) to Black (900).

motion.philosophy: High motion, zero friction. Every interaction must have a fluid, hardware-accelerated response. The app should feel alive, especially with live streaming data.

live_tick_flash.strategy: Wrap the streaming number in a Framer Motion span. When the 'value' prop changes, trigger this animation.

command_palette_cmdk.content: fixed left-[50%] top-[50%] z-50 w-full max-w-2xl translate-x-[-50%] translate-y-[-50%] rounded-2xl border border-white/50 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-2xl shadow-[0_40px_80px_rgba(14,165,233,0.15)] overflow-hidden

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You MUST implement this light theme globally. There is no dark mode toggle.
You MUST use Framer Motion extensively. The user specifically asked for 'high with motions'. Wrap pages in AnimatePresence and map lists to staggered children animations.
Implement the ⌘K command palette using 'cmdk' or shadcn's Command component. It must be accessible from anywhere and allow searching entities and jumping to forecasts.
For the live price streaming (WebSocket simulation or actual), you MUST implement the `live_tick_flash` motion.span to visually indicate a price update.
Do not use generic gray backgrounds for cards. Use pure white (#FFFFFF) against a slate-50 (#F8FAFC) app background. The contrast must come from delicate shadows and crisp borders.
NEVER use generic placeholder text. If adding mock data, make it realistic enterprise finance data.
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes in kebab-case representing their role (e.g., `data-testid="command-palette-trigger"`).
For the AI Analyst page, utilize streaming typewriter text effects to simulate the Sonnet 4.6 generation.
Ensure the Command Palette has a glassmorphism backdrop (`backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/20`) to create depth against the light UI.
